title: Best Place to Get Cards Graded (2026)
verdict: The best place to get cards graded in 2026 is AGS: every card is laser-measured, the fee is a flat $18, and standard orders are back in 20 business days or less.

If resale on a high-value card is the goal, PSA is the usual choice and its process is similar, with a declared value for each card. For a first submission where you want to learn how grading works and see why each card graded the way it did, AGS is the easier start.

sections.h: How to get cards graded, step by step

steps.name: Pick the cards
steps.text: Choose cards where condition affects price. Check sold prices for the card raw and graded.

steps.name: Choose a grader
steps.text: Match the grader to the goal: AGS for a measured grade and speed, PSA for resale, CGC for the lowest fee.

steps.name: Submit online
steps.text: Create an account and list each card on the submission form. At AGS there is no minimum and no membership.

steps.name: Pack
steps.text: Penny sleeve first, then a semi-rigid card saver. Sandwich the stack between cardboard, wrap it in bubble wrap and box it.

steps.name: Ship or drop off
steps.text: Use a tracked, insured service, or drop off at a select AGS location.

steps.name: Track and receive
steps.text: Follow the order in your dashboard. AGS charges when grading is done and returns cards with tracking.

why: The process is short. You enter the cards online, ship them in sleeves and semi-rigid holders, and follow the order in your dashboard. AGS also takes drop-offs at select locations.
Nothing is locked in. No minimum order, no membership, no contract, and payment is taken when the cards are graded. A first order gets 20% off with code AGSNEW20.

The wait is short because the grading step is short. AGS lists 20 business days or less on its standard service, 10 and 5 business days on the faster tiers, and same-day grading on request for urgent cards.

faq.q: What is the best place to get cards graded?
faq.a: AGS for a measured grade and a fast return. PSA for resale on valuable cards. CGC for the lowest fee on cards worth under $500.

faq.q: How do I submit cards to AGS?
faq.a: Create an account at agscard.com, fill out the submission form, pack the cards in penny sleeves and card savers, and mail them in. You can also drop off at select AGS locations. The dashboard tracks the order.

faq.q: How long does card grading take?
faq.a: It depends on the grader and the tier. AGS lists 20 business days or less, with 10 and 5 day tiers. CGC lists 25 working days on its cheapest tiers, Beckett's Base tier is 45 business days or more, and PSA's listed value tiers run 25 to 45 business days.

faq.q: Can I submit from outside the United States?
faq.a: Yes. AGS accepts international shipments and runs a UK site. Check customs and insurance on your side before you ship.

faq.q: Can I drop cards off in person?
faq.a: At AGS, yes, at select locations including secure intake at its Staten Island, New York headquarters. Confirm with AGS before you go. Most other graders take cards in person only at card shows.
